root.name: Ruy Lopez: Open
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. O-O Nxe4

overview: Black grabs the e4 pawn instead of defending e5, and the main line goes 6.d4 b5 7.Bb3 d5 8.dxe5 Be6. White gets a queenside pawn majority and pressure on e5 and the b-file or d-file. Black gets active pieces, a bishop on e6 and ...Bc5, and the e4 knight, trading a loosened queenside for activity.

white_ideas.idea: Play c3 and Nbd2 to challenge the e4 knight and bring a piece to d4.
Use the Nd4 outpost and a queenside majority; Bxd5 or Nxe5 tactics.

black_ideas.idea: Keep the pieces active with ...Be6, ...Bc5 and ...Nc5.
Hold e5 with ...Nc5 or ...Bc5 and play against d4 or the b3 bishop.

typical_structures.structure: Open e-file after dxe5, White queenside majority (a/b/c) against Black's d-pawn-less centre.

character.notes: Concrete tactics around the e4 knight and the d5/e5 pawns; Black's lines are forcing and move-order sensitive.

gambit.notes: White regains e4 by force after d4 and Re1 or d4 and Nxe5.

soundness.notes: Fully sound, a long-standing main line at the top.

structure.notes: Centre pawns come off, giving open lines for the pieces, unlike the Closed Ruy.

level.notes: Deep theory with a number of lines (Dilworth, 9.Nbd2, 9.c3) that must be known and strategic ideas to match.

sublines_that_differ.name: 6.Re1
sublines_that_differ.how: Quieter, with an early exchange of knights and a pinned or traded centre.

character.reason: Concrete play around the e4 knight and open lines where one slip loses material.

gambit.reason: The e4 pawn comes back by force.

structure.reason: The e-pawns come off and the game turns on open lines and outposts.

approach.reason: A main-line choice at every level.

level.reason: Long theoretical lines and subtle strategy around e5 and d4.

plans.reason: The d4 outpost is the characteristic idea.
